decisions.reason: The desk system sits squarely in our premium office competence and flexible-workplace direction, so after several years it looks more like a retained platform than an option we should close.

The floor cushions are a peripheral accessory line whose market uncertainty should largely be resolved by now, and with limited strategic importance we would reallocate attention to stronger interior concepts.
This sofa showed the weakest early signal and, after years to prove itself in a crowded adjacent category, it no longer justifies keeping the option open.
The high standing table remains a good fit with adaptable office and conference environments, and its adjacency to the core range makes continued presence worthwhile.
Although rugs are more distant from our manufacturing core, the collection supports the move toward holistic, design-led interiors and still merits being kept as a strategic complement.
